title: Synthesis and Crystal Structure of a Neodymium Isopropoxide Chloride, Nd6[OCH(CH3)2]17Cl

material_class.structural_family: μ6-Cl-centered Nd6 trigonal prism alkoxide cluster

synthesis.procedure: Sodium isopropoxide was prepared from sodium (1.3 g-atom, 0.055 mole), isopropyl alcohol (20 ml), and benzene (40 ml) and added to a gently refluxing solution of neodymium trichloride (4.6 g, 0.018 mole) in isopropyl alcohol (40 ml). The suspension was refluxed for 12 h then centrifuged. The light blue mother liquor was filtered and the residue was washed with benzene (2 × 25 ml). The combined extracts were evaporated to dryness in vacuum. The blue solid was crystallized from toluene (−15 °C) as light blue needles. Yield 6.2 g. The compound did not melt nor decompose when heated in a sealed capillary to 300 °C.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux, centrifugation, vacuum evaporation; crystallization from toluene
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifuged; light blue mother liquor filtered; residue washed with benzene (2 × 25 ml); combined extracts evaporated to dryness in vacuum; crystallized from toluene at −15 °C as light blue needles.

properties.summary: The magnetic susceptibility follows the Curie–Weiss law χ = CM/(T + Θ) from 7.5–100 K, with μeff = 3.22 B.M. per Nd, Θ = −2.8 K, and CM = 1.293.

measurements.name: effective magnetic moment (μeff)
measurements.conditions: Curie–Weiss fit, 7.5–100 K; PAR model 155 VSM calibrated with HgCo(NCS)4

source_locations.location: Experimental methods; results paragraph on magnetic susceptibility
